policy.participantPromptTemplate: 你是独立参评 Agent。唯一任务输入目录是 <workspace>。每次 shell 调用必须显式将 workdir 设置为此目录。先阅读 TASK.txt，仅根据该目录材料完成任务与 REPORT.md。严格遵守可修改范围，TASK.txt 只读。不读取父仓库、其他目录、其他 Agent、历史会话、参考答案或外部验收器；不使用外网，仅允许自己启动的本地测试服务；不派发子 Agent。不依赖主会话上下文，不索取答案。报告实际验证及未覆盖边界，停止自己启动的服务后交付。自测可通过标准输入执行，避免创建无关文件。

grading.machine: frozen external verifier plus immutable-input/scope checks
grading.semanticReview: coordinating agent reviews source support, requested scope and report limitations
grading.caseWeighting: report each case separately; accepted task count is descriptive only
grading.adjudication: adjudication.json; frozen raw scores retained; same B04/B09 supplemental rules apply to every model
grading.secondaryReview: All eight B09 project rewrites independently reviewed under anonymous A-H labels in a fresh context; final coordinating-agent decisions in semantic-blind-review.json

metrics.primary: all required task checks plus scope and content review
metrics.wallTime: Session task_started to task_complete; includes model and tool execution, excludes queue delay
metrics.tokens: null unless exact per-run usage is available
metrics.cost: null unless actual billing data is available

limitations: Single valid trial per model/case, insufficient for stable ranking.
Host tools are not OS-isolated; fresh context and exported inputs do not establish adversarial secrecy.
Requested model ID and actual turn_context model/effort are recorded; provider internal backend identity is not independently verified.
Unavailable models are recorded as not run; no substitute models are used.
No API or alternate-client runs are mixed into native subagent comparisons.
modelAvailability: All eight screenshot model IDs accepted by the subagent call; observed turn_context model names are recorded per run

reasoningDecision.rule: Preserve existing medium runs; archive non-medium runs and rerun in a fresh context; explicitly request medium for all subsequent spawns
